guard_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised

nspecial: points two fingers forward at an opponent and holds the pose, his coat swaying
sspecial: dashes forward very low and fast, turns around on the spot and strikes behind him with a quick elbow, then turns back into the stance
uspecial: crouches low and gathers himself, then springs straight up with his arms tucked, his coat streaming below him
dspecial: raises one forearm in a calm parry, then answers with a fast backhand strike
ultimate: spreads his arms wide and throws his head back, his coat and hair lifting, then settles into a stronger stance
